# The mutation score floor (#3519), beside .github/coverage-floor.txt: one `<area> <percent>` line per
# area of scripts/mutants.sh (`sh scripts/mutants.sh areas` lists them; the weekly `cards` job
# reports as its week's set, cards-<set>). mutants.yml's `report` job runs
# `sh scripts/mutants.sh floor`, which holds each area's score in the run's table (killed over
# killed and survived, in percent) to its line: a run that scores an area under it fails, and the
# error names the area. An area with no score that run, a `–` score (no mutant judged) or a floor of
# 0 is not held; a line naming no area fails the run, so a mistyped area never goes ungated unseen.
# A pull request's run checks these lines and holds no score to them.
#
# How it is raised: by hand, in the pull request of an audit (#3490 parts 2 to 7) that raises an
# area's score, to a few points under the lowest score the area's shards have reached since. Each
# week runs one shard of an area, so its score moves with the shard: hold it under the lowest, not
# the mean. Never lower a line to get a run green; give a survivor its test, or its reason in
# .cargo/mutants.toml. An area at 0 has no settled score yet; it gets a line once its shards have.
#
# Set from the scores of mutants.yml's runs on main up to 2026-11-11 (#3519's pull request lists them).
